scope: Exact identities and version dispositions for N-b-001 through N-b-035. Identification does not establish that the complete required body has been acquired or read. Original register tokens and canonical bibliography records are preserved.

sources.author: Richard Montague
sources.title: Pragmatics and intensional logic
sources.evidence: Publisher identity and author note read. Pacuit's author-hosted neighborhood-semantics lecture explicitly locates the original generalized modality motivation at p. 73. The direct lecture fetch failed, while its indexed text was available.

sources.author: Saul A. Kripke
sources.title: Semantical Considerations on Modal Logic
sources.evidence: The institutional original-paper indexed title and opening explicitly identify the source and its quantifier discussion. The direct body request returned 403. The contemporaneous JSL review separately confirms the contribution and pages; no review is counted as the source body.
sources.distinct_versions: Canonical Kripke1963 is Semantical Analysis of Modal Logic I: Normal Modal Propositional Calculi, 67-96, DOI 10.1002/malq.19630090502. That work is not substituted for the quantified-modal Considerations presentation.

sources.evidence: Publisher identity and abstract read. Preserve the exact PA expansion and classifications of axiom/rule subsets. Later references containing different volume/page figures are not used to replace this primary record.

sources.evidence: Publisher identity and original extract read. Its schematic reflective-closure method remains distinct from a bare modern KF acronym.
